endpoint_contract.coefficient_scope: A arbitrary CNL, including nonreduced; O original CNL DOMAIN; alpha:A->O arbitrary LOCAL map, including nonflat/noninjective; beta:O->Omega specified injection into algebraically closed field; exact scalar tower.
endpoint_contract.ordinary_map: j_K(f)=pointwise alpha(f); O tensor_A M_K is the exact original ordinary base change.
endpoint_contract.specialization_domain: The entire original X.Fn A m, not only the union of ordinary modules.
endpoint_contract.specialization_codomain: Fin m -> X.Fn Omega (W.d+1), the original ambient classical families.
endpoint_contract.specialization_definition: The unique F that lies in some original ClOrd(U_K,e), e>=c, and has ctrl(F)=pointwise beta alpha(f), when such F exists; zero otherwise.
endpoint_contract.choice_order: Fix all original ring, embedding, character, WtRep and directed-level data. Prove uniqueness across levels by a common refinement and maximum depth. Define one sp on all ambient functions before K,e,basis,precision,positive operator or away sum is selected.
endpoint_contract.away_sum_hypothesis: Exactly the source: the Omega-valued finite sum carries every U_K-fixed ambient family into the U_K-prime-fixed ambient space. No assumption that the resulting A-valued function is ordinary is added.
endpoint_contract.eigenvalue_hypothesis: A nonzero classical eigenvector for any positive normalized operator or any finite indexed away sum. For away integrality no classical-space preservation hypothesis is added.
endpoint_contract.simplification: The finite O-module of all untwisted coordinates is generated by finite coset evaluations. Any eigenoperator preserves this module, so the adjugate determinant trick proves integrality without requiring its image to lie in the original classical level.
additional_proved_results: On every M_K the same sp is the actual integral inverse q_K,e^-1 after original coefficientwise base change.
Omega tensor_A M_K maps isomorphically onto the literal classical ordinary space for every e>=c.
